The '''Twin Nebulae''' were a pair of [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]] in the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]], the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]] and [[Kiax Nebula/Legends|Kiax Nebula]].

They were named for a pair of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] trickster gods, [[Ivax]] and [[Kiax (god)|Kiax]], in honor of the navigational havoc they played on [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] for millennia.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
